decisions.reason: As a large, expanding and R&D-active firm in a growing industry, we would keep this recently launched workstation because there is no clear sign it falls below aspiration levels and available slack supports giving an adjacent product more time to prove itself.

We would keep this thermal inkjet printer because it is close to the core offer, visibly commercialized, and in the absence of evidence of a serious shortfall a boundedly rational management in a growing firm would continue backing it.

We would keep this piezo inkjet printer because it fits the firm’s strategy of application-specific coding solutions and digital traceability, and the firm’s resources and current expansion make continued support of a young product likely.
